headline: Find the barriers before your users do
lede: Scan pages, components, and flows for WCAG gaps, then track every fix from first finding to verified pass.
summary: An audit workspace for teams who ship interfaces people can actually use.
about: Accessibility Auditor keeps manual review and automated checks in one queue. Findings cite a success criterion, a screenshot, and the person who owns the fix.
The sample audits cover checkout, account settings, and a marketing page so you can see how a real review moves.
